records.decision: The method for the user interface design will be to look at what people like and dislike about existing remote controls, decide on the functionalities to keep, and design the remote control to be sleek and simple with frequently used buttons made bigger and more strategically placed.
rationale: The problems people have expressed with existing remote controls are too many buttons, unclear button functions, button sequences required for certain functionalities, and small buttons. The preference is to keep the number of buttons to a minimum, make frequently used buttons bigger and more strategically placed, and keep the design sleek and simple.
